text: This man just drove his car into a lake, and it's starting to sink.
He has about one minute while the car still floats.
Movies say: wait for it to fill, then open the door.
Bad news: before it fills, over a thousand pounds of water holds that door shut.
It opens once the car is full, but by then he's underwater, holding his breath, in the dark.
Good news: experts say seatbelt off, window open, get out now.
Power windows usually work at first, so he rolls it down right away.
Stuck? He breaks a side window near the corner. Never the windshield.
Waiting for it to fill is the last resort, not the plan.
And that's what really happens when your car goes into water.
